metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Safeguard I (special autonomy + central backstop) + Mod9 (no re-suppression after porosity): does rising Indonesian P1 post-Suharto plus credible autonomy yield DURABLE PEACE - a BETTER outcome than East Timor's full secession (case10)? Falsified if Jakarta erodes the 2005 Helsinki MoU and conflict reignites. Aceh is a SUB-STATE region -> proxied via the parent state + qualitative evidence (no standalone WGI).
metadata.notes: Reference-based record. Indonesia carries real MI v2 re-scores; Aceh is a sub-state proxy entity with no resolved scores. 1976-2005 GAM insurgency, 2005 Helsinki MoU -> 2024; scored ~2004 vs 2024. Within-country contrast with East Timor (case10), which exited.

pre_event.event_description: Tail of the 1976-2005 GAM separatist insurgency; the December 2004 tsunami devastated Aceh and helped catalyze the August 2005 Helsinki Memorandum of Understanding, which traded special autonomy and local political participation for GAM disarmament under international monitoring.

context.fragmentation_mechanism: separatist insurgency resolved by special autonomy
context.backstop_details: Central state (Jakarta) special-autonomy backstop via the 2005 Helsinki MoU and the 2006 Law on Governing Aceh (LoGA), monitored by the EU/ASEAN Aceh Monitoring Mission (AMM). Safeguard I configuration: devolved self-rule with a credible central guarantor.

Indonesia.notes: Inputs resolved live via mi.datasource (country_ref + year). WGI 2025-anchored 0-100. Post-Suharto democratization with rising state capacity; the central state is the credible backstop for Aceh's special autonomy.

Indonesia.outcome_summary: Durable peace as predicted. The 2005 Helsinki MoU and 2006 LoGA held: GAM disarmed, became the local party Partai Aceh, and won provincial power through elections; no return to insurgency through 2024. Indonesian P1 rose 0.379 -> 0.505 and MI 0.557 -> 0.566 (Tier 3). A materially BETTER counterpart outcome than East Timor's full secession - autonomy held without re-suppression (Mod9 satisfied).
key_events: GAM disarmament + Partai Aceh electoral participation

Aceh.outcome_summary: Qualitative (sub-state, no WB data): peace held under special autonomy. Former GAM cadres govern via Partai Aceh; sharia-flavored provincial autonomy administered within Indonesia; no secession, no re-militarization. Strong contrast with East Timor (case10), which exited the state.

analysis.overall_assessment: Hard stress test passed and a clean Safeguard I / Mod9 confirmation. The cleanest 'autonomy held' counterpart to East Timor's exit, with a within-country contrast (both involve Indonesia).
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: A credible special-autonomy bargain with a strengthening central state can convert a long separatist insurgency into durable peace without re-suppression (Mod9) - a measurably better outcome than secession under comparable parent-state conditions (East Timor).
analysis.baseline_impact: None; second Safeguard I confirmation (with Colombia, case23) and the first clean Mod9 'no re-suppression' instance.
analysis.data_note: Aceh is a non-WB sub-state proxy entity; its scores are intentionally null and its assessment is qualitative.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
